verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs documents an official hosted MCP server that Claude or any other MCP client can connect to. Through it, users can create, configure and manage agents in natural language with nothing to install locally. A probe confirms the hosted-MCP docs page exists. Its support for connecting agents to external MCP servers is client-side and is not credited here. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted MCP server, documented details on authentication/setup and the exposed tool set.
